message.hexagonsafio2.necesita_plataform: Place the ship on top of a Ship Platform
item.hexagonsafio2.dilitio.desc: Green crystal full of energy. Used to craft the Dilithium Flask.
item.hexagonsafio2.bioxita.desc: Turquoise crystal. Used with dilithium to craft the Dilithium Flask.
item.hexagonsafio2.frasco_dilitio.desc: Concentrated fuel. 3 are needed to craft the ship engine.
item.hexagonsafio2.motor_mejorado_nave.d: Improved version of the ship engine.
item.hexagonsafio2.corazon.desc: Right click: gives you 1 extra max heart (until you die).
item.hexagonsafio2.corazon_limbo.desc: Right click: fully heals you and gives 3 extra hearts (until you die).
item.hexagonsafio2.corazon_amarillo.desc: Right click: gives you 5 yellow absorption hearts.
item.hexagonsafio2.ambar_fosil.desc: Amber with something trapped inside. Used in the ship wings and cabin.
